subject: Where can I find the generateMap.pl script?

messages.author: 4597b236c0106ed0
messages.subject: Where can I find the generateMap.pl script?
parts:
Hi Gavin,

I am interesting in working with TitanCNA on a non-model pathogen to primarily study gene conversion (LOH) as well as CNVs. Since It is a non-model, I need to generate my own mappability file using the HMMcopy suite.  However, I cannot seem to find the perl script referenced "util/mappability/generateMap.pl > mappability.bw".  

In fact, I'm not entirely sure what this file path even means, is it pointing to a script located in a directly "util" subdirectory "mappability"?  Several other functions, such as "readCounter" are in a similar format.

I am fairly certain HMMcopy is installed correctly, as the help options do appear when i enter "wigsToRangedData" for example, though not "readCounter" 

Any help would be appreciated, and apologies for my introductory-level knowledge of R.

Michael

messages.author: 71cefeaaa3659875
messages.subject: Re: Where can I find the generateMap.pl script?
parts:
Hi Michael,

The HMMcopy suite consists of 2 components, an R package and tools to be run from the command line.  Please refer to http://compbio.bccrc.ca/software/hmmcopy/

util and mappability both refer to directories found in zip that can be downloaded here: http://compbio-bccrc.sites.olt.ubc.ca/software/request-to-download?sw=HMMCopy

wigsToRangedData is an R function that can be accessed once the R package is downloaded and installed directly from Bioconductor. This is distinct from the executables (to be run on the command line) such as generateMap.pl and generateMap

Hope this helps.

Best,
Gavin
